title: The Handover
place: Civic Records Office, the civic block
note: Fable, 2026-10-23, third pass: the file is the motive (Sky); Vale carries it out of the Office at shift change and delivers it to Security tonight, so the take lands before the hand-off. variants.A/B/C each complete; the screen reads variants[pick]. 'short' is the one-line summary. Empty arrays/strings are omitted by the layout. The file is story only: no file objective, the game does not model it yet.
dataSrc: Waymark, 2026-10-25 (brief 062 'Portraits and ids', Glyph, Fable and Waymark): the briefing's mission data, read by Latch's Briefing.cs (HostBriefing.cs BriefScreen.Load: brief.json first, then mission.json brief). target: role is the roles[] id of the man to take (his photograph is portraits/card_<role>); at is where the briefing's Target leader lands, a mission.json destination as a place id (d:<name>, as camera.place): d:Official entrance, the door Vale comes out of at 4:50 under the canopy (timeline), not the guard's public door (Glyph N1 on 0.2.122, briefs/041/port-progress.md); tools/missions/handover/brief.ts rejects an unknown one. ways: one per way in; id is the text.json less.briefing.ways key and, for front-door, mission.json windows[0].id (route A); contact a roles[] id (its face portraits/face_<contact>); steps up to three kit icons after the face (front door: Inez, the guard's badge, the door; pickup: the driver, the car, the take). pickup has no window yet. clock: the marks from mission.json timeline (0:00 the start, 4:30 the handover chime, 7:30 the close: rivals take Vale or the car leaves). camera: the briefing frame (062 §5: overhead-pickup, the Office door right of centre at play zoom), 5 m on from d:Meet driver, opening yaw; the same frame the host derived before this data existed, so the screen does not move.

A.hook: Popovic has a file on you.
handler: The cameras caught your cell. Councillor Popovic put it on paper.
No networks here. The file lives in a folder and in his head.
Reach him first. Then we learn who else has read it.

dossier.target: Councillor Popovic. Holds the file on you.
dossier.location: Civic Records Office, the civic block.
dossier.window: Shift change, 4:30. He leaves soon after.
dossier.objective: Take him alive before it reaches Security.

intel: Inez, café waitress. She knows the door guard.
A rival crew wants him too.
Cameras are watched by people. People can be turned.
A.short: Take Councillor Popovic alive before he delivers the file. Deliver him to the getaway car.
